summary: Baidu, Inc. filed a Form 6-K with amended memorandum and articles of association and a press release announcing its voluntary conversion to a dual-primary listing on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange. The company adopted the new governing documents by special resolution on August 26, 2026, effective September 1, 2026, increasing authorized share capital to accommodate Class A, Class B, and preferred shares. This is a corporate structural change, not a special-situation transaction. The filing contains no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other event. Watch for continued trading in both markets; no risk-arb angle applies.
